output.rationale: The requirement specifies a rated maximum voltage of 15 kV rms. Among the candidates, the product 'CROWN-ARMV' from the CROWN business unit is an engineered-to-order (ETO) arc-resistant metal-clad medium-voltage switchgear lineup that supports voltage classes from 5 to 38 kV, including 15 kV, and meets IEEE C37.20.7 Type 2B standards. This product is the most suitable match for the technical requirement.
